catalog.hero_subtitle: Interactive 2D & 3D Euclidean geometry and trigonometry visualizers with live mathematical proofs and physical telemetry.

thales-theorem.title: Thales' Theorem
thales-theorem.description: Explore why any angle subtended by a diameter at the circle circumference is always a right angle (90°).

angle-at-centre.title: Angle at the Centre Theorem
angle-at-centre.description: Demonstrate that the angle subtended by an arc at the centre is exactly twice the angle subtended at the circumference.

angles-in-same-segment.title: Angles in the Same Segment
angles-in-same-segment.description: Verify that angles in the same segment of a circle subtended by the same chord are identical.

cyclic-quadrilateral.title: Cyclic Quadrilateral Theorem
cyclic-quadrilateral.description: Prove that opposite angles of an inscribed cyclic quadrilateral are supplementary and sum strictly to 180°.

tangent-radius.title: Tangent-Radius Perpendicularity
tangent-radius.description: Show that a tangent line at any point on a circle is strictly perpendicular to the radial vector at the point of contact.

alternate-segment.title: Alternate Segment Theorem
alternate-segment.description: Explore why the angle between a tangent and a chord through the point of contact equals the angle in the alternate segment.

tangents-from-external-point.title: Tangents from an External Point
tangents-from-external-point.description: Demonstrate that two tangents drawn to a circle from a common external point are equal in length and form a cyclic kite.

perpendicular-chord-bisector.title: Perpendicular Chord Bisector
perpendicular-chord-bisector.description: Prove that the perpendicular bisector of any chord passes through the circle centre and bisects the subtended arc.

unit-circle-helix.title: Unit Circle, Six Trig Functions & 3D Helix Waves
unit-circle-helix.formula: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1  |  r(θ) = (R cos θ, y(θ), R sin θ)
unit-circle-helix.description: Explore trigonometric ratios projected onto 3D cylindrical wave helices with harmonic projection walls.

law-of-sines.title: Law of Sines & Circumcircle Invariant
law-of-sines.formula: a / sin A = b / sin B = c / sin C = 2R
law-of-sines.description: Verify the ratio of side lengths to opposite sines equals circumdiameter 2R, bridging to spherical geometry on S².

law-of-cosines.title: Law of Cosines & Generalized Pythagorean Projection
law-of-cosines.description: Understand the generalized Pythagorean theorem with bilinear interaction rectangle and spherical cosine law.

angle-sum-identities.title: Angle Sum, Difference & Rotation Matrix Composition
angle-sum-identities.description: Derive sine and cosine compound angle formulas from stacked right triangles and SO(3) Euler rotation frames.

cookie.title: Cookie & Privacy Choices
cookie.text: We use privacy-preserving, aggregated technical analytics to understand screen sizes and improve our geometry visualizers. We do not track you across websites, profile you, or sell your data. Choose whether to allow analytics cookies.
